summary.text: Greg Walker is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 41, serving since 2006.
The caucus page lists Walker as chair of the Family and Children Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Walker holds a B.A. in business finance from Indiana University and an M.B.A. from Wesleyan University.
The page says he represents Bartholomew County and a portion of Johnson County and lists Walker as ranking member of the Elections and Ethics committees.
